newsitem.title: CANADA: National shareholders vote against pay cap.
newsitem.headline: National shareholders vote against pay cap.

text.p: Shareholders of the National Bank of Canada voted on Wednesday against a minority shareholder activist's proposal that limits be set on the salaries of the bank's executives.

After long discussions on the proposal and four others proposed by Yves Michaud, shareholders voted 84 percent against the pay cap resolution. Michaud, who won the right in a Quebec court to make his proposals, had asked that shareholders adopt a resolution limiting the aggregate remuneration for the bank's most highly paid officer to not more than 20 times the average employee's salary.
